name: AKTU Syllabus Data API
description: Static JSON API for the institutes affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow, and the courses/branches each institute offers.

rr_id.summary: Every entity carries a frozen RR-ID identifying it across the API and future datasets (see /docs/rr-id-reference.md).

prefixes.C: course = C + university serial (2 digits) + 2-digit course serial within that university
prefixes.B: branch = B + university (2) + course (2) + 2-digit branch serial within that course; identifies a (course x branch) offering pair
prefixes.I: institute = I + university serial (2 digits) + 3-digit institute serial
prefixes.S: RESERVED for future subjects = S + 4-digit flat serial (subjects are many-to-many with branches, so never hierarchical; relationships will be edge records carrying year/semester)

rr_id.subjects: S prefix is reserved for the future syllabus dataset (flat IDs; subject x branch relationships will be edge records carrying year/semester).

endpoints.description: This manifest: endpoints, counts, integrity summary.
Whole dataset as one nested JSON tree (institutes -> courses -> branches).
One institute with its courses and branches (nested).
Flat list of every (institute, course, branch) offering.
Course taxonomy with slugs and counts.
One course: every institute offering it.
Source-data cross-check report (published verbatim, not fixed).
One university with its full course catalogue.
Same payload as /courses/{slug}.json, addressed by the frozen RR-ID.
One (course x branch) pair: every institute offering it.
Same payload as /institutes/{code}.json, addressed by the frozen RR-ID.
Append-only RR-ID registry: natural key -> id, sequences, prefix grammar.

changes: added the RR-ID system: frozen identifiers for universities (U), courses (C), course x branch pairs (B), institutes (I); S reserved for subjects
added universities.json, universities/{rr_id}.json, branches/{rr_id}.json and RR-ID aliases for institute/course detail files
added rr_id fields to every existing endpoint (strictly additive)
initial publication: institutes, courses, branches (nested tree, flat mirrors, per-entity detail files, integrity report)
